I am facing this issue multiple times what should I do?

issue:-23f1000436@se2001:~/se2001/BPT2_problem_1$ client_loop: send disconnect: Connection reset

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
It usually happens with a unstable internet connection.

However I would recommend using tmux so that even if you get disconnected your work is not lost.

Basics of how to use tmux:

When you login for the first time after this, type in tmux and press enter. It will look like terminal only but with a bar on the bottom.

When you lose connection suddenly, login again and then type tmux a (which stands for attach), and all your open terminals and editors will be back in the same state.

Disclaimer: Do not keep opening new tmux sessions using tmux without closing the previous ones.

There are many other things you can also do using tmux such as split panes and multiple windows, you can look into it if interested.
